author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Architect desk lamp: a clean conical shade (short back, wide open mouth, symmetric about its 45-degree axis) on two straight arm struts through a small ring hinge, over a domed base on a flat foot; reads as a desk lamp at 48 in both themes.
omissions: The rounded back of the shade (drawn as a straight back side) and the lamp's switch detail.
